description: This Java enum defines a rating scale for books in the book tracking application. It includes predefined rating options, their string representations, and associated numeric values, along with utility methods to convert between these representations.

classes.name: RatingScale
classes.description: An enumeration representing various rating options for books, including their string labels and numeric values, with utility methods for conversions.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string label of the rating.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the RatingScale matching the given Double value, or NO_RATING if input is null.

methods.name: toDouble
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the Double value associated with a given RatingScale, or empty if null.
